coordinateSystem.axes: Unity X,Z in meters; Z increases north; Y height not yet defined

calibration.xScale: SVG x linearly mapped to Unity X [0..1500]
calibration.zScale: SVG y inverted and linearly mapped to Unity Z [1500..0]
calibration.note: Independent axis scales correct the nonsquare illustration panel; review before building production terrain.

notes: Road centrelines and IDs are preserved; points are sampled copies of SVG paths.
Junction locations and memberships come from accepted reference labels, without snapping road geometry.
Road crossings have NOT been automatically converted into traversable connections.
Height Y, drivable surface, terrain and physics are NOT included.
